name: Zombodze
description: Original royal capital under Ngwane III

name: Lobamba
description: Royal capital established by Sobhuza I; ceremonial centre of the kingdom

name: Nyonyane (Execution Rock)
description: Sacred execution site; traditional judgement place of the Swazi kings

name: Lubombo Mountains
description: Eastern rhyolite plateau; site of 1846 battle; natural eastern border of Eswatini

name: Hhohho
description: Northern Highveld region; traditional Swazi heartland

name: Manzini
description: Colonial administrative centre in the Middleveld; previously called Bremersdorp

name: Great Usuthu River
description: Main river draining Swaziland southward; spiritual significance; site of royal ceremonies

name: Mdzimba Mountain
description: Sacred mountain north of Lobamba; ancestral shrine of the royal family
